titulo.estudio: Een overeenkomst en open punten vastleggen

intro: Summarise agreed obligations, the person responsible, the date and the questions that are still open.

palabras.significado: to record; to put on file

texto: A negotiation record separates what has already been agreed from what still has to be confirmed. Each commitment needs a person responsible and a deadline; do not write down as agreed a proposal that is still being assessed.
